places.name: EUE/Screen Gems Studios Atlanta (now Trilith Studios)
places.connection: Primary production facility and soundstages for interior sets and special effects. Most of the show's indoor scenes were filmed here.

places.name: Byers' House (Season 1)
places.connection: Filming location for Joyce Byers' iconic house, where Will communicates through Christmas lights. Featured prominently in Season 1.

places.name: Hawkins Middle School / High School (Patrick Henry High School)
places.connection: Filming location for both Hawkins Middle School and Hawkins High School exteriors and many interiors for Seasons 1-3.

places.name: Hawkins National Laboratory Exterior (Emory University Briarcliff Campus)
places.connection: Exterior shots of the ominous Hawkins National Laboratory, particularly in Season 1.

places.name: Melvald's General Store (Bradley's Olde Tavern)
places.connection: Filming location for Melvald's General Store, where Joyce Byers worked in Season 1.

places.name: Benny's Burgers (Tiffany's Kitchen)
places.connection: Filming location for Benny's Burgers, the diner where Eleven first seeks refuge after escaping the lab in Season 1.

places.name: Sattler Quarry (Bellwood Quarry, now Westside Park)
places.connection: Filming location for Sattler Quarry, where Will's 'body' is discovered in Season 1.

places.name: Hawkins Police Station (Douglasville City Hall)
places.connection: Filming location for the exterior and interior of the Hawkins Police Station, where Chief Hopper works.

places.name: Starcourt Mall (Gwinnett Place Mall)
places.connection: Primary filming location for the Starcourt Mall in Season 3, including Scoops Ahoy, The Gap, and the epic final battle.

places.name: Hopper's Cabin (Stone Mountain Park)
places.connection: The cabin where Hopper and Eleven live in Seasons 2 and 3 was a set built in a wooded area of Stone Mountain Park.

places.name: Creel House (Claremont House)
places.connection: Filming location for the infamous Creel House, a pivotal setting in Season 4.

places.name: Pennhurst Mental Hospital (Berry College - Ford Buildings)
places.connection: Filming location for the Pennhurst Mental Hospital, where the character Victor Creel is held in Season 4.

places.name: Lenora Hills House (Byers' California home)
places.connection: Filming location for the Byers' family home in Lenora Hills, California, featured in Season 4.

places.name: Camp Hero State Park (Montauk Project inspiration)
places.connection: The real-world Camp Hero, a former military base, served as a key inspiration for the fictional Hawkins National Laboratory and the 'Montauk Project' concept for the series.
